baseline_models.focus_anchor: The perfect verb طَغَىٰ, with the unrestricted relative مَن, classifies a person by an accomplished crossing beyond a limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both mapped inventories place disobedient excess at the root's center. The construction therefore names not a particular offense but an agent-shaped condition in which a boundary or due measure has been exceeded.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the literal boundary crossing and makes it the person's classificatory condition.
Passing beyond limit or measure confirms that the verb profiles excess rather than one named deed.

changed_reading.before: A generic label for someone who did wrong.
changed_reading.after: A classification of whoever has made the crossing of due measure into an accomplished mode of agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: طَغَىٰ can carry the root's image of water or another material force rising beyond its proper capacity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human subject is rendered hydrodynamically: excess first rises, then becomes a sweeping force able to carry more than the subject alone. This adds propagation and loss of containment to moral overstepping.

activation_trace.role: Rising water and a sweeping force supply overflow as the material behavior of the person's excess.
Flood, sea, blood, and analogous powers exceeding measure make propagation beyond containment explicit.

changed_reading.before: The person merely steps across a rule.
changed_reading.after: The person rises past capacity and becomes a current of excess whose effects can sweep outward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of طَغَىٰ also generates the branch image of a طاغوت as a head of deviation that turns others from a good path.
baseline_models.mechanism: A completed act of excess can mature into a social position: the transgressor becomes an organizing center that redirects other people, not only an isolated boundary-crosser.

activation_trace.role: The head of misguidance supplies a social center that diverts others from the path of good.
The singular-or-collective head of deviation expands personal excess into organized influence.

changed_reading.after: An individual can become a directive center through which excess recruits and redirects a collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of طَغَىٰ has branch images of a smooth rock, a mountain top, and an elevated place.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb admits a topographic analogy: the subject has risen to a conspicuous high surface, but its smoothness suggests poor footing. Excess is elevation without secure purchase.

activation_trace.role: The smooth rock and mountain top supply exposed elevation together with unstable footing.
The rock or elevated place reinforces a spatial model of rising beyond one's stable level.

changed_reading.before: Transgression is an abstract moral excess.
changed_reading.after: Transgression can be pictured as occupying an exposed height whose apparent superiority lacks traction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root as طَغَىٰ can name both transgressive excess and a dominant punishment or destructive force.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root permits a reversible force profile: what goes beyond measure as agency can be met or overtaken by an overpowering form of the same excess. The causal return is an exploratory inference, but the two poles are supplied by the focus inventory itself.

activation_trace.role: A dominant destructive punishment supplies the possible force that overtakes the one who exceeded.
Overpowering penalty tied to transgression or flood supplies the root-internal reversal from excess to being overwhelmed.

changed_reading.before: The verb describes only the offender's outward action.
changed_reading.after: The root also shadows that action with a stronger excess capable of rebounding upon and mastering its agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence turns the baseline head-of-deviation model into a public technology of rule: exit from obedience is coupled to mustering a population, raising a call, claiming lordship, and asserting supreme elevation. طَغَىٰ thus names excess that installs itself as a rival center of command.

activation_trace.role: The head of deviation anchors the focus verb to an organizing and redirecting social role.
The tyrannical king supplies the focus-root profile of a ruler whose excess coerces others.
Raised public calling supplies the broadcast channel through which private excess becomes collective direction.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the authority position the transgressor claims for himself.
Departure from obedience supplies the negative break that precedes the construction of rival authority.
Driving and gathering a group toward one aim supplies the mechanism for concentrating a population around the claimant.
Greatness and domineering elevation supply the vertical claim by which excess presents itself as supremacy.

structural_cues: The focus verb recurs exactly at 79:17 as the diagnosis that launches the Pharaoh episode, but that uncued root recurrence is used only structurally here.
The rapid sequence 79:21-24 moves from denial and disobedience to gathering, proclamation, and a claim of highest lordship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disobedience, gathering, public call, lordship, and elevation; I infer that these form a causal social machine for طغيان. A live alternative is that they are merely consecutive symptoms of an already complete transgression.

changed_reading.before: طَغَىٰ is chiefly an individual's crossing of a moral limit.
changed_reading.after: طَغَىٰ can be the installation of a rival public sovereignty that gathers others, amplifies its voice, and converts self-elevation into rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately coordinated clause gives boundary excess an evaluative engine. The agent repeatedly privileges the beneficial, near, lower life; transgression is therefore not only a spectacular breach but a preference ordering that continually selects immediacy over a higher claim.

activation_trace.role: Crossing the limit supplies the focus condition whose sustaining choice the next clause reveals.
Preferential choice supplies the selection operation that repeatedly maintains excess.
Life as benefit and good supplies the attractive value being selected.
The lower or nearer supplies the horizon within which the agent's preference is confined.

structural_cues: 79:38 is joined directly to the focus classification by وَءَاثَرَ.
The جواب of the فَأَمَّا construction is deferred until 79:39, so preference belongs inside the profile before its outcome is named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preferential selection of near-life benefit; I infer that this choice sustains the crossing named by طَغَىٰ. It could instead be a consequence or diagnostic sign rather than the cause of transgression.

changed_reading.before: Transgression is a single act of going too far.
changed_reading.after: Transgression is also an economy of attention and value that keeps choosing the immediate lower life and thereby normalizes excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired أَمَّا clause defines the counter-mechanism: anticipated accountability at an upright station enables active restraint of the self's inclination. Read through that opposition, طَغَىٰ is failure of inner government, where inclination is allowed to pass its stopping point and acquire outward force.

activation_trace.role: Passing beyond limit supplies the condition that an effective stopping faculty would prevent.
Fear that anticipates harm supplies prospective awareness of consequence.
Standing or station supplies the accountable position before the Lord that orients restraint.
Checking and prohibiting action supplies the active brake absent from the transgressive profile.
The self's force and disposition supply the internally governed power rather than an external object alone.
The inclination of the self supplies the directional pull that restraint must interrupt.
Falling into an abyss gives the unchecked inclination a spatial consequence without replacing its desire sense.

structural_cues: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ at 79:37 is answered by وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ ... وَنَهَى at 79:40.
Both classifications are followed by matching فَإِنَّ ... هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ result clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a balanced contrast between excess and fear-plus-restraint; I infer that the second exposes the missing regulator in the first. A live alternative is that the two sides list independent traits rather than inverse mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: طَغَىٰ primarily describes visible domination or outward wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: طَغَىٰ begins inside as an ungoverned preference: anticipated accountability fails to halt the self's inclination before it crosses its limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence legitimates great height, abundant water, and massive elevation only within estimation, proportional completion, and anchorage. Against that architecture, the focus root's flood and high-place branches define طَغَىٰ more precisely as magnitude detached from measure and support, not greatness or rising in themselves.

activation_trace.role: Sweeping water supplies excess magnitude that has escaped its proper containment.
The elevated rock or place supplies height that can be tested against the context's measured and anchored elevations.
Estimating and measuring supplies the prior determination within which created magnitude belongs.
Raising something supplies legitimate elevation rather than treating all height as transgressive.
A roof that holds a structure supplies load-bearing height and support.
Straightness and completion in the thing itself supply proportional finishing after elevation.
Water's appearance, entry, and abundance supply contained fertility as a counter-image to destructive overflow.
A solid elevated mass supplies genuine height with material density.
Fixity and rooted stability supply the anchorage that distinguishes ordered elevation from excess.

structural_cues: 79:27-32 alternates immense vertical construction with proportional completion, water provision, and mountain anchoring.
The focus arrives after this ordered material scene and after the greater calamity, making scale itself an explicit local concern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, raised structure, water, solid heights, and anchorage; I infer that this architecture calibrates the focus root's flood and high-place images. The scene may instead function only as evidence of creative power, leaving the calibration implicit.

changed_reading.before: طَغَىٰ means becoming too great or rising too high.
changed_reading.after: طَغَىٰ is not magnitude itself but magnitude that has broken loose from measure, proportional completion, and anchorage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence moves through extraction, engulfing completeness, quick release, swimming or running, and precedence, yet culminates in governance of an affair. It sharpens the flood baseline by contrast: intense motion need not be طغيان when its velocity remains ordered; transgression is acceleration that escapes or usurps governance.

activation_trace.role: A flood-like material power supplies the moving force whose relation to governance the opening sequence tests.
Pulling a thing from its settled place supplies forceful initiation of movement.
Engulfing comprehensiveness supplies movement carried through to total reach.
Quick drawing and removal supply release and acceleration.
Running or swimming supplies free transit through a medium.
Advancing and racing supplies relative velocity and precedence.
Managing an affair by attending to its outcome supplies directional governance over prior motion.
The affair or state supplies the ordered field within which the moving agents operate.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 is a tightly linked participial sequence whose final member governs an affair.
The repeated verbal nouns intensify each motion before the sequence resolves into تدبير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forceful motion that culminates in management; I infer a contrast between governed intensity and runaway excess. The unidentified referents of the opening oath leave open whether this kinetic contrast should directly calibrate human agency.

changed_reading.before: The flood image makes طَغَىٰ equivalent to any intense or fast-moving force.
changed_reading.after: طَغَىٰ is runaway intensity: motion ceases to serve an ordered affair and instead escapes or captures its governing end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's overpowering-punishment branch becomes a full reversal. The one who expanded beyond bounds is seized; exemplary restraint follows; the blaze is exposed; and the apparent outward current terminates in an enclosing destination. Expansive agency is mastered by a stronger containment.

activation_trace.role: Dominant destructive punishment supplies the root-internal possibility that excess can return as an overpowering force.
Punishment associated with transgression or flood connects outward overflow to being overwhelmed.
Taking to account for wrongdoing supplies the first arrest of expansive agency.
Punishment that deters others converts the arrest into a socially limiting example.
Exposure and uncovering remove concealment before the final containment.
The fiercely kindled fire supplies the overpowering medium named as the result.
Joining a gathering or enclosing destination supplies the terminal container for previously unbounded movement.

structural_cues: The Pharaoh exemplar ends in divine seizure and exemplary punishment at 79:25.
The generic focus clause receives its result at 79:39, where the exposed blaze is identified as the encompassing destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seizure, deterrent punishment, exposure, intense fire, and enclosure; I infer a mirrored reversal from outward overflow to forced containment. A simpler live alternative is linear retribution without a force-pattern mirror.

changed_reading.before: The transgressor moves outward without limit until an unrelated penalty is imposed.
changed_reading.after: The outward overflow carries a reversal pattern: it is arrested, exposed, and enclosed by a force more dominant than the one it projected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing temporal field joins a fixed anchorage for the Hour, a final endpoint with the Lord, the near or lower life, and a retrospectively brief stay. This activates طَغَىٰ as practical denial of a terminus: the agent treats a bounded near interval as though it were the unbounded horizon.

activation_trace.role: Going beyond a limit supplies the focus action recast here as temporal overextension.
Fixity and rootedness supply a determinate anchorage for the Hour even when its date is unknown.
Nearness supplies the short horizon that the transgressor mistakenly treats as ultimate.
The endpoint at which a thing terminates supplies the fixed bound denied in practice.
Remaining in a place supplies the stay that final perception compresses to a brief interval.

structural_cues: Preference for the near life at 79:38 is followed by questions about the Hour and its endpoint at 79:42-44.
79:46 closes by compressing worldly duration to an evening or morning when the Hour is seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near life, an anchored Hour, an endpoint, and a brief-seeming stay; I infer that transgression lives as if the near interval had no terminus. The alternative is that these closing verses correct chronology without redefining the focus verb's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: طَغَىٰ crosses a static moral line in the present.
changed_reading.after: طَغَىٰ also overextends the present, treating a near and bounded stay as if it could outrun its fixed terminus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant branch in which طغي القوم concerns their sound. It remains anchored in the focus root and is materially supported by gathering and raised proclamation in 79:23-24. Downstream prose should present it as an acoustic-social analogy, not translate طَغَىٰ as shouting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: طَغَىٰ is linked through the ط غ و inventory to the branch image of a group's sound, allowing excess to be modeled as amplified voice.

activation_trace.role: The group's sound supplies the odd but root-attested acoustic image for socially amplified excess.
Gathering a group toward one purpose supplies the collective body whose voice can be amplified.
Raised calling supplies the audible act through which the ruler occupies the collective sound field.
Speech spreading among people supplies propagation of the proclaimed supremacy beyond one mouth.

changed_reading.before: Transgression is a silent inner quality later expressed in isolated deeds.
changed_reading.after: One exploratory form of transgression is acoustic collectivization: a ruler gathers people so that his excessive claim becomes the sound that fills their public space.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the smooth rock and elevated-place branches are remote from the ordinary verbal reading. It remains anchored in two mapped focus inventories and gains a coherent contrast from domineering height versus solid, anchored mountains. Downstream prose should call it a topographic analogy, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's smooth-rock and high-place branches let the transgressor's elevation be tested for footing and anchorage.

activation_trace.role: The smooth rock and mountain top supply an exposed perch whose surface offers little grip.
The elevated place reinforces a summit image internal to the focus root.
Domineering greatness supplies the claimant's asserted summit.
A solid elevated mass supplies the context's contrasting model of real height.
Rooted stability distinguishes an anchored mountain from the transgressor's smooth false summit.

changed_reading.before: Self-elevation is secure so long as the transgressor remains visibly on top.
changed_reading.after: The claimed summit is a smooth, unanchored perch: conspicuous height that imitates a mountain while lacking the stability that makes height endure.

strongest_changes: The Pharaoh sequence turns individual limit-crossing into a public sovereignty that gathers, proclaims, and redirects a collective.
The immediate preference clause identifies a repeatable value-selection mechanism behind the excess.
The paired fear-and-restraint clause recasts transgression as failed inner governance before it becomes outward domination.
Measured creation distinguishes legitimate scale from flood-like or elevated magnitude that has escaped proportion and anchorage.
Seizure and final enclosure reverse the transgressor's outward expansion into being mastered by a stronger containing force.
summary.what_was_special: The very short, predicate-opening focus clause became mechanistically dense because its split root inventory spans moral limit-crossing, hydrodynamic overflow, political headship, unstable height, and overpowering punishment. Whole-surah sequences then made these branches interact without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal direction from preference or failed restraint to transgression is reader-supplied; those features may instead be effects or diagnostics.
The kinetic reading depends on treating the unidentified opening oath sequence as a calibration of governed motion.
The punishment, acoustic, and smooth-summit readings use form-distant root branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The exact طَغَىٰ recurrence at 79:17 strongly orients the Pharaoh model but was not used as a context citation because that root is absent from context_root_cues.
